reason: The plugin primarily monitors DeepSeek account balances and session usage, provides low-balance and completion alerts, and adds related account, layout, recharge, and host-gated session controls; credential handling and optional deletion warrant human review.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中监控账户余额与会话用量，并提供低余额及完成提醒、账户切换、充值入口和可选的会话控制。
summaries.en: Monitors DeepSeek Harness account balances and session usage while providing low-balance and completion alerts, account switching, a recharge link, and optional session controls.

capabilities: Reads account balances and per-session token and cost usage
Stores and switches DeepSeek account API keys
Writes the selected account key to the host credentials seam
Can expose permanent session deletion when the host advertises that capability
Stores wallet settings and usage data locally
